::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `CropImageBorders` {-}

Removes the solid border surrounding a scanned image and saves the result to another image file.
Returns true if image was successfully saved.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
boolean CropImageBorders(string inputImagePath,
                         string outputImagePath,
                         number colorTolerance,
                         string baseColor)
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `boolean`

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| `string` inputImagePath | The input image. |
| `string` outputImagePath | Where to save the image. |
| `number` colorTolerance | (Optional) How far a pixel's color channels may deviate from `baseColor` and still be considered part of the border. Default is `10`. |
| `string` baseColor | (Optional) The color of the border area to crop away (e.g., the color of the wall or scanner bed surrounding the actual content).<br>\linebreak Default is `"white"`. |


:::
